Input image 1 is a composition and aged-paper material REFERENCE ONLY. Ignore/remove ALL orange annotations, numbered orange circles, brackets, lines, callout numbers, and slot index numbers. Do not reproduce reference game's title, English text, difficulty labels, or boilerplate.
Visual design: a large antique paper ledger centered against a near-black subtly plum gothic study background. The paper should look physically tangible and hand-painted: visible fine paper fibers, softly mottled ivory/grey-beige pulp, old creases, foxing near the edges, slightly torn irregular edges, gently bent top-right corner, stacked sheet edges and soft cast shadow. Rich painterly anime-game prop art, restrained aged metal and dark plum ink details. No flat clean beige website rectangle. No gold luxury frame. Keep central reading areas pale, calm, and high contrast; dark charcoal lettering with gentle printed ink character, readable Korean.
Composition: paper occupies ~80% width and ~90% height. Top centered title exactly "불러오기". Small ink X at top right. A faint engraved horizontal line below title. Top AUTO SAVE row has subtle double ink rules and tiny aged metal binding details on outer ends, softly tinted selected strip. Below it are THREE manual save rows, separated with fine imperfect ink rules. Every row has a landscape thumbnail at LEFT, title and smaller location/event text in CENTER, date/time and elapsed time right aligned at RIGHT. Do not split into modern rounded cards or add headings for columns.
Exact text: top row title "자동 저장", secondary "현관 홀", date "2026.10.23 · 21:42", duration "01:24:08". Second row title "현관 홀", secondary "저택에 도착한 밤", date "2026.10.23 · 21:18", duration "01:00:32". Third and fourth rows each say only "비어 있음" next to empty thumbnail outlines. First two thumbnails show dark hand-painted gothic mansion foyer interiors. Use restrained plum ink line at left of selected top row. Empty rows unobtrusive but legible.
At bottom right: small text action "뒤로" and a slightly worn deep-plum paper label button "불러오기", light ivory text. No footer explanations, no captions, no annotation text, no instructional labels, no numbering, no orange marks, no watermark, no browser chrome. The layout itself must explain the UI. Deliver a single polished full-screen mockup with coherent paper texture, generous spacing, straight-on readable view, no extreme perspective.
